title: 'The Gift of Deceit': Netflix Reveals the Title of Its New Brazilian Series and Teaser Featuring Marieta Severo, Alice Wegmann, and Nanda Costa
summary: Netflix has announced the title of its new series, The Gift of Deceit, premiering later this year with Marieta Severo, Alice Wegmann, Nanda Costa as well as a large ensemble cast.
body_markdown:
São Paulo, September 10, 2026 —


“


You speak the truth. The truth is your gift of deceit."


Netflix has announced the title of its new series,


The Gift of Deceit


, premiering later this year with


Marieta Severo


,


Alice Wegmann


,


Nanda Costa


as well as a large ensemble cast. There are also new photos and a teaser featuring vocals by singer Liniker, who re-recorded Caetano Veloso's song “Dom de Iludir” for this production — a fitting choice for a gripping story, directed by Mauro Mendonça Filho, which blends elements of melodrama and suspense and is full of intrigue, secrets and twists. Amid the luxury of Rio's elite, art collector Lúcia Rossetti (Marieta Severo) and her daughter Maíra Rossetti (Alice Wegmann) have a complex and turbulent relationship. When their paths cross with Irina's (Nanda Costa), the web of intrigue and tension intensifies. The cast also stars José de Abreu, Felipe Camargo, Luciana Paes, Laila Garin, Rui Ricardo Diaz, Heloisa Jorge, Allan Souza Lima, Jonas Bloch, Giovanna de Jesus, José Mata, Thiago Justino, Hamilton Dias, Laura Vick, Yanna Lavigne and Rosanna Viegas.


The Gift of Deceit


is produced by Conspiração for Netflix, with Amaia as associate producer. It was created by Diane Maia and Mirna Nogueira, who also serves as head writer, and co-writing by Carol Rodrigues, Felipe Sholl, Josefina Trotta and Pedro Riguetti. Produced by Renata Brandão and Luísa Barbosa, with Diane Maia and Tania Pacheco serving as executive producers, Mauro Mendonça Filho serves as general director, with Gabriela Amaral Almeida and Daniela Carvalho also directing.


About Netflix


Netflix is one of the world’s leading entertainment services offering TV series, films, games and live programming across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.


About Conspiração:


Conspiração is one of Brazil’s leading independent production companies, founded by filmmakers and built around Brazilian artistic creation. With 10 International Emmy nominations – the most for any independent production company in Latin America – Conspiração co-produced


I'm Still Here


, winner of the Academy Award® for Best International Feature Film and the Golden Globe® for Best Actress – Drama. The production company is also behind five of the biggest box office hits in Brazilian cinema. Conspiração's projects have premiered at major international festivals, including Cannes, Berlin, Sundance, Venice and Toronto. With more than 50 feature films, 30 series and 45 documentaries produced, totaling more than 30 million tickets sold at the box office and over 300 awards, the company combines a strong artistic vision with projects that reach both Brazilian audiences and the international market, rooted in the strength of Brazilian storytelling.
